decision: Owner decision of 2026-09-30 (status/journal.jsonl): the first level of datasets/ holds only bad_english, symbolic_english and neuro_english. The legacy corpora that feed them moved unchanged (byte for byte, same file names and hashes) into datasets_archive/, where they remain the provenance inputs and the gold-SOP arbiter.
resolver: lib/dataset-paths.mjs: resolveDatasetPath(storedPath), archived(relative), corpusDir(name), corpusNames(). tools/datasets/verify-corpus.mjs, tools/eval/registry.mjs, tools/eval/baseline.mjs, lib/row-world.mjs and training/cli.mjs resolve stored paths through it.
frozen_records_keep_old_paths: eval/suites/*/manifest.json and the `world.dir` field of corpus rows (datasets/formalizer-v1/world)
datasets_archive/*/manifest.json, config/dictionary/*.tsv and lib/ud-to-sop/labels.mjs (provenance comments; their content is hashed by run manifests)
note: These records pin file hashes or describe past runs and are never edited; a path they store is read through the resolver or through this table.
